description: Q# generation benchmark. Problems are the evaluator's quantum cases; the algorithm strings are verbatim values the production evaluator passed to the generator between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-25, weighted like production (26 of 29 requests were QPE, 3 were Shor). Used by run_codegen_eval.py, which calls the real model and is not run in CI.

cases.problem: Calculate the ground state energy of the FeMoco nitrogenase cofactor to chemical accuracy
cases.algorithm: Preparing Eigenstates and Thermal States, followed by fault-tolerant Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE)

cases.problem: Simulate the ground state energy of a 50-atom transition metal catalyst active site
cases.algorithm: Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) with multiconfigurational eigenstate preparation

cases.problem: Find the ground state phase diagram of the two-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model
cases.algorithm: Fault-tolerant Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) with quantum eigenstate preparation; use qubitization or interaction-picture Hamiltonian simulation

cases.problem: Simulate the ground state energy of a 50-atom lithium cobalt oxide battery cathode material
cases.algorithm: Preparing Eigenstates and Thermal States, implemented with fault-tolerant Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE)

cases.problem: Compute the binding energy of a drug candidate to the heme active site of cytochrome P450
cases.algorithm: Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) with a chemistry state-preparation routine; alternatively, fault-tolerant eigenstate preparation

cases.problem: Estimate the ground-state energy of the 2D Fermi-Hubbard model at half filling
cases.algorithm: Quantum Phase Estimation with qubitization and multiconfigurational eigenstate preparation

cases.problem: Compute the binding energy of a light nucleus from a pionless effective field theory Hamiltonian
cases.algorithm: Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) with fault-tolerant ground-state preparation; finite-temperature extensions for thermal states

cases.problem: Prepare a thermal state of a frustrated quantum magnet and estimate its energy
Compute the reaction barrier of nitrogen fixation at the nitrogenase active site
cases.algorithm: Fault-tolerant Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) with quantum eigenstate preparation, preceded by active-space reduction and a multiconfigurational trial state

cases.problem: Factor a 2048-bit RSA integer to test post-quantum readiness
Factor a 2048-bit RSA key to assess post-quantum migration urgency
Simulate real-time dynamics of a lattice gauge theory with a fermion sign problem
cases.algorithm: Trotterized Hamiltonian simulation of a lattice gauge theory
